CONNECT TO PS5 WITH JCRW / CHIAKI

In short: Jcrw is a Chiaki-based Remote Play client running on your TV. The PS5 sends video and audio over your network; Jcrw displays them on the TV and forwards controller input to the PS5. Pairing is a one-time setup. After that, select the console to start a session.

1. Enable Remote Play on PS5
On PS5, open Settings → System → Remote Play and turn on Enable Remote Play. Keep the PS5 and TV on the same home network.

2. Find the console in Jcrw
Wait for the console to appear on Jcrw’s home screen and select it. If it is not discovered automatically, choose Add console / Add manually and enter the PS5 IP address. Find it on PS5 under Settings → Network → Connection Status.

3. Enter your PSN Account ID
This is not your PSN Online ID (the visible username), and Base64-encoding your username will not work. Chiaki needs the PSN account’s numeric Account ID encoded as 8 bytes in Base64. To obtain it once, use psn-account-id.py from Chiaki’s open-source repository. It opens PSN sign-in through Sony’s login page; enter your password only on Sony’s official sign-in page. Never give your PSN password, session cookie, or token to Jcrw, us, or an unknown lookup site. Treat your Account ID as personal and do not share it.
Chiaki guide: https://git.sr.ht/~thestr4ng3r/chiaki/tree/master/item/README.md#obtaining-your-psn-accountid

4. Get a one-time PIN from PS5
On PS5, open Settings → System → Remote Play → Link Device. Enter the PIN shown there into Jcrw. The PIN expires; generate a new one on PS5 if needed.

5. Register and play
Press Register in Jcrw. After successful registration, the PS5 appears on the home screen. Select it to connect. If connection fails, check that the PS5 and TV are on the same network, Remote Play is enabled, and the PIN is current.

What does each field mean?
• PSN Online ID: your visible account name.
• PSN Account ID: the account identifier Chiaki asks for, encoded as 8-byte Base64.
• Pairing PIN: a one-time code generated by PS5.
• PS5 IP address: used only if you need to add the console manually.

Optional video: FlipScreen Games’ Chiaki PS5/PS4 setup video (it shows the Steam Deck interface, so Jcrw menus differ): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ay90MnuYuZA. The video’s Account ID lookup link may be a third party; never enter your PSN password on a third-party page.

Controller and session shortcuts
On a game controller, hold D-pad down to toggle subtitle translation. Hold D-pad up to toggle voice-over. On the TV remote, press OK twice quickly to open the in-session menu. Turn session tips off in Settings; reopen this guide from Settings → Help.

JCRW USER GUIDE

1. PS5 Remote Play
On PS5, open Settings → System → Remote Play → Enable Remote Play. When console pairing is needed, start the add/register console step in Jcrw, then open Settings → System → Remote Play → Link Device on PS5 and enter the one-time PIN shown on screen. Keep the TV and PS5 on the same local network.

2. PSN registration fields
PSN Online ID is your visible account name. PSN Account ID is a different numeric account identifier encoded as 8 bytes. Encoding your username as Base64 is incorrect. Follow the upstream Chiaki guide to obtain the Account ID and use the Base64 value of its 8-byte little-endian representation: https://git.sr.ht/~thestr4ng3r/chiaki/tree/master/item/README.md#obtaining-your-psn-accountid. Never give your PSN password or session token to this app or third-party lookup sites.

3. Install the APK on Android TV
Copy the APK to a USB drive and open it with a file manager. If prompted, allow unknown-app installation for that file manager. Alternatively use Android platform-tools on a computer: `adb connect TV_IP:5555`, then `adb install -r Jcrw.apk`; approve USB debugging on the TV. An update preserves app data when its signing key matches.

4. Controller
To pair a DualShock/DualSense with the TV, hold Create/Share + PS, then use Settings → Remotes and Accessories → Add accessory on the TV. A controller connected to the TV sends input to the TV; one connected to PS5 sends input to PS5. Simultaneous connection to both is not guaranteed. Map buttons under Jcrw Settings → Map controller buttons.

5. Subtitle translation
Before launching a game, prepare subtitle translation in Settings and grant screen capture permission. When the stream starts, move the region selector over the subtitle area and save it. ML Kit and Tesseract OCR process images on the device. Depending on your provider, only recognized text is sent to its online service; screenshots are not sent. DeepL, OpenAI, and Gemini require keys and may charge fees under their service plans. Enter keys in Settings and do not share them. The target language can be changed separately.

6. Performance and troubleshooting
Keep the OCR region tight around subtitles. Higher resolution and faster scanning use more device resources. If input lags, try 720p/30 FPS, disable voice-over, and prefer wired networking. If text is not detected, check the region and source language. If translation fails, check the provider, API key, and internet connection.
